notes: Leaf PNGs are raw topil() RGBA buffers: they do NOT bake layer masks, blend modes, opacity or clipping, so masked/blended leaves are not appearance-equivalent standalone images.
No white-keying or thresholding was applied; alpha comes from the PSD itself.
Composite uses psd.composite(force=True, alpha=0.0, color=(1,1,1)): genuine source-layer rendering.

The forced composite is a forced layer render: it is NOT verified full-front-view parity and NOT UV parity. Per-layer alpha / opacity / blend mode are preserved in this report; the leaf PNGs themselves do not bake masks, blend modes, opacity or clipping.
Native alpha channel of the source PSD is preserved (no white-keying, no repainting). Forced compositing can spill shadows/halos outside the intended shape.

fidelity_white_vs_cached.definition: white-composited native rendering vs cached merged PSD RGB, foreground pixels (native alpha > 0)
fidelity_white_vs_cached.mae_rgb_definition: mean over pixels and over the 3 RGB channels of |native - cached|
fidelity_white_vs_cached.max_abs_definition: max over pixels of max over the 3 RGB channels of |native - cached| (single-channel maximum error, 0..255)
fidelity_white_vs_cached.max_rgb_sum_abs_definition: max over pixels of the SUM of the 3 channel absolute differences (reference only, not the headline error)
